patch_description: The current approach spends heavily on broad kicks and uses energy to rank most proposals, even though energy is only loosely correlated with routing quality. This version reserves a small initial quota for kicked starts, then concentrates LP calls on exhaustive two-switch neighborhoods ranked by both dual-price gain and energy. It keeps a compact, diverse archive, searches the incumbent frequently, and uses occasional rotations and longer kicks to escape local basins. Batches are smaller than the current program’s nine-call batches to allow more frequent adaptation to LP results.
